articles.summary: Exciting Update... Mixpanel MCP Server beta now also supports ChatGPT and Gemini 🎉 | @everyone Ready to get started? Check out the help docs with the step-by-step instructions for ChatGPT (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#option-5-chatgpt-openai) and Gemini (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#option-4-google-gemini-cli). This beta is available to all projects based in US data center; we're working to expand this to EU and IN! Here are some resources to learn more & get started: • Implementation Docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview) (reminder: Organization admins must enable the beta feature first in Settings > Org > Overview) • Mixpanel MCP Server blog (https://mixpanel.com/blog/mixpanel-mcp-server/) And as always, we want to hear from you! Share your feedback with the team directly via the form on the docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview).
articles.title: Mixpanel MCP Server Beta Now Supports ChatGPT and Gemini!

articles.summary: Refreshed Mixpanel Guides Are Live! 📚 | @everyone We’ve given Mixpanel Guides a refresh—clearer examples, improved navigation, and new end-to-end workflows to help you go from setup to insights faster. Start exploring with these featured Guides: • 💡 Continuous Innovation (https://docs.mixpanel.com/guides/guides-by-topic/continuous-innovation): Learn how product teams use Mixpanel to observe, analyze, decide, and act. • 🧭 Self-Guided Tours (https://docs.mixpanel.com/guides/self-guided-tours): Take quick, interactive walkthroughs of core Mixpanel workflows. • 💰 Grow Revenue (https://docs.mixpanel.com/guides/guides-by-use-case/grow-your-usership/grow-revenue): Connect user behavior to conversion and retention to uncover what moves the business. Each Guide breaks down the why and how behind key analytics workflows, helping your team learn Mixpanel through real examples and practical steps. 👉 Explore all refreshed Guides here: docs.mixpanel.com/guides/mixpanel-introduction (http://docs.mixpanel.com/guides/mixpanel-introduction) ✨ P.S. More refreshed and new Guides are coming soon—stay tuned!
articles.title: Explore the Updated Mixpanel Guides for Enhanced Analytics Insights

articles.summary: 📊 Connect Your Langfuse LLM Metrics to Mixpanel | @here Building an AI product or feature? Now you can easily see how your LLM outputs tie to user-level outcomes. We've partnered to integrate LLM observability data from Langfuse — such as cost, latency, accuracy, and model version — with product analytics data in Mixpanel. Now you can answer questions like: • 🙋 “Are my most active users also the ones who are most engaged with my LLM content?” • 📈 “Does interacting with the LLM feature relate to higher retention rates?” • 🤔 “How does the LLM feature impact my conversion rates?”* Add your Langfuse data to Mixpanel in seconds: 👉 https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/tracking-methods/integrations/langfuse
articles.title: Integrate Langfuse LLM Metrics with Mixpanel for Better Insights

articles.summary: It's officially here!! Mixpanel MCP Server now supports EU and IN projects 🌎 🔥 | @everyone We've heard all your feedback, and we're excited to launch MCP support for our customers using our EU and India data centers (https://docs.mixpanel.com/changelogs/2025-11-20-mcp-in-eu). Organization admins can enable this feature for their entire organization in Settings > Org > Overview. From there, your teams can talk to their Mixpanel data in natural language through AI tools, like Claude Pro and Free, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor. Get started today with the help of our support docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp). 🗣️ And as always, we want to hear from you! Share your feedback with the team directly via the form on the docs (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/features/mcp#overview).
articles.title: Mixpanel MCP Server Now Supports EU and IN Projects! 🌍✨
